partners.mechanism_chain: TBX20 (HGNC:12016) —DISRUPTS→ Notochord Development Pathway (GO:0007499); TBXT (HGNC:11784) —DISRUPTS→ Notochord Development Pathway (GO:0007499); Notochord Development Pathway (GO:0007499) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital heart defects (HP:0001627); Notochord Development Pathway (GO:0007499) —LEADS_TO→ Sacral agenesis (HP:0003329); Notochord Development Pathway (GO:0007499) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal ossification of vertebral bodies (HP:0004607); Notochord Development Pathway (GO:0007499) —LEADS_TO→ Persistent notochordal canal (HP:0030131). Loss-of-function mutations in TBX20 disrupt the notochord development pathway, leading to congenital heart defects (Disease A). Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in TBXT also disrupt the notochord development pathway, leading to sacral agenesis, abnormal ossification of vertebral bodies, and persistent notochordal canal (Disease B). The convergence on the notochord development pathway represents the shared mechanism.
